nodes.name: Subject has engineered a production-grade Python pipeline to automate ADNI T1-weighted MRI preprocessing. The system transmutes raw 3D NIfTI files into training-ready 2D sequences for temporal deep learning operations. Architecture features a modular 4-stage protocol with GPU acceleration and cross-platform support, integrating HD-BET and ANTs assets. Identified as a final-year thesis mission, this tool successfully eliminates data wrangling latency in Alzheimer's research workflows

nodes.name: Subject has engineered a high-performance Web-based 3D visualization tool engineered for analysis of Alzheimer’s MRI datasets. TECH: React, TypeScript, Three.js. FEATURES: Spherical rendering of thousands of image slices with advanced filtering protocols. OPTIMIZATION: High-velocity delivery via AWS CloudFront CDN, reinforced with Level of Detail (LOD) rendering and progressive loading protocols for seamless operational use. DUE TO ADNI-IDA LONI DATA PRIVACY, THIS PROJECT IS PERSONAL-USE ONLY. No data was uploaded into Github

nodes.name: This subject orchestrated a comprehensive Deep Learning evaluation to classify Alzheimer's atrophy, leveraging the pre-processed data streams from the Alzheimer's Disease Processing Pipeline. The operation deployed 16 architectural variants across 2D, 3D, and Trimodal Fusion modalities, utilizing ResNet, EfficientNet, and ViT backbones. OUTCOME: Rigorous statistical validation via 1,000-iteration Bootstrap and Friedman tests identified the 3D-ResNet protocol as the superior model (83.54% Accuracy), proving that volumetric spatial integrity outweighs the complexity of multimodal fusion mechanisms.
